snippet.title: PVK2 1.0 Release Trailer
snippet.description:
PVK2 1.0 featuring the Buccaneer, new maps, new modes, and more!

Download for free on Steam at https://play.pvkii.com

PVK2 is a fast-paced FPS featuring a robust melee combat system and weapons from the days of Pirates, Vikings, and Knights!

https://discord.gg/pvkii
